items.exampleEn: The company does not have the capability to build such large ships.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司沒有能力建造這麼大的船。

items.exampleEn: Universities recruit students from all over the world.
items.exampleZh: 大學從世界各地招收學生。

items.exampleEn: The coach resigned after the team lost ten games in a row.
items.exampleZh: 球隊連輸十場比賽後，教練辭職了。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother gets a small pension every month.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶每個月領一小筆退休金。

items.exampleEn: Workers who are hurt at work can ask for compensation.
items.exampleZh: 在工作中受傷的員工可以要求賠償。

items.exampleEn: Making violins by hand is a skilled job.
items.exampleZh: 手工製作小提琴是一份需要技術的工作。

items.exampleEn: The test checks your competence in reading and writing.
items.exampleZh: 這項測驗檢驗你的讀寫能力。

items.exampleEn: He is competent enough to run the shop alone.
items.exampleZh: 他的能力足以獨自經營這家店。

items.sentenceEn: The hospital is trying to recruit more nurses from other cities.
items.sentenceZh: 那家醫院正努力從其他城市招募更多護理師。

items.audioEn: My uncle resigned from his job at the hotel to take care of his new baby.
items.audioZh: 我叔叔辭去飯店的工作，好照顧他剛出生的寶寶。
items.questionZh: 說話者的叔叔為什麼辭職？
options: To start his own small hotel
To move to a new city

items.sentenceEn: We need skilled workers who can repair old machines.
items.sentenceZh: 我們需要會修理舊機器的熟練工人。

items.sentenceEn: The new phone has the capability to translate speech instantly.
items.sentenceZh: 這支新手機有立即翻譯語音的功能。

items.stemEn: The ____ for the cancelled flight was a free night at a hotel and a dinner.
items.stemZh: 航班取消的補償是免費住一晚飯店和一頓晚餐。

items.stemEn: After she retired, she lived comfortably on her ____ from the government.
items.stemZh: 她退休後，靠政府發的年金過得很舒適。

items.passageEn: Mrs. Tsai is a bus mechanic, and this year she won the city's award for skilled workers. Ten years ago, the bus company recruited her straight from school. Today, her colleagues trust her competence: she can find a problem in an engine just by listening to it. Last year, a bigger company offered her a higher salary, but she did not resign. "My team is competent, and the compensation here is fair," she said. The company even pays extra into her pension. Now she helps test the capability of every new electric bus before it goes on the road.
items.passageZh: 蔡太太是一位公車技師，今年她得到了市政府頒給熟練技術人員的獎。十年前，公車公司在她一畢業就招募了她。如今，同事們都信任她的能力：她光聽引擎的聲音就能找出問題。去年，一家更大的公司開出更高的薪水，但她沒有辭職。她說：「我的團隊很能幹，這裡的薪資報酬也很公道。」公司甚至額外為她提撥退休金。現在她負責在每一輛新電動公車上路前，幫忙測試它的效能。

questions.questionZh: 去年另一家公司開出更高的薪水時，蔡太太怎麼做？
options: 馬上辭職，換到新公司上班

questions.questionZh: 蔡太太現在還幫公司做什麼？
options: 設計公車的新行駛路線
招募剛從學校畢業的學生
管理全公司員工的退休金

items.promptZh: 她是一位非常能幹的翻譯，總是準時交稿。
referenceEn: She is a very competent translator who always finishes her work on time.
She is a very competent translator, and she always delivers her work on time.
rubricZh: competent 指能幹的（例如 a competent translator、very competent 等）
「準時交稿」可寫，例如 finishes her work on time、delivers on time 等
說習慣，時態配合內容（例如 is、always finishes 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 recruit 造一個句子，說說一個團體或公司想招募什麼樣的人。
referenceEn: Our club wants to recruit more members who love hiking.
The restaurant is recruiting cooks for its new branch.
rubricZh: recruit 後面接要招募的人（例如 recruit members、recruit cooks 等）
時態配合內容（例如 wants to recruit、is recruiting 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："A small robot company in Taichung wants to recruit twenty skilled engineers this year. The boss says that a degree is not enough; she looks for real competence. Each applicant must show what their own robot can do, and a panel tests its capability in a real factory. The company also tries to keep its workers happy. Its compensation is higher than average, and it pays extra into each worker's pension. Last year, only one engineer chose to resign, and she left to start her own company. \"A competent engineer can find a job anywhere,\" the boss says, \"so we must give them reasons to stay.\""；改後："Mrs. Tsai is a bus mechanic, and this year she won the city's award for skilled workers. Ten years ago, the bus company recruited her straight from school. Today, her colleagues trust her competence: she can find a problem in an engine just by listening to it. Last year, a bigger company offered her a higher salary, but she did not resign. \"My team is competent, and the compensation here is fair,\" she said. The company even pays extra into her pension. Now she helps test the capability of every new electric bus before it goes on the road."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："台中一家小型機器人公司今年想招募二十位熟練的工程師。老闆說光有學位是不夠的，她要找的是真正的能力。每位應徵者都必須展示自己的機器人能做什麼，評審小組會在真正的工廠裡測試它的效能。這家公司也努力讓員工開心。它的薪資報酬高於平均，還會為每位員工額外提撥退休金。去年只有一位工程師選擇辭職，她離開是為了自己創業。老闆說：「能幹的工程師到哪裡都找得到工作，所以我們必須給他們留下來的理由。」"；改後："蔡太太是一位公車技師，今年她得到了市政府頒給熟練技術人員的獎。十年前，公車公司在她一畢業就招募了她。如今，同事們都信任她的能力：她光聽引擎的聲音就能找出問題。去年，一家更大的公司開出更高的薪水，但她沒有辭職。她說：「我的團隊很能幹，這裡的薪資報酬也很公道。」公司甚至額外為她提撥退休金。現在她負責在每一輛新電動公車上路前，幫忙測試它的效能。"
